# Luna Repo Clinic

> Agent-owned, bounded repository health triage for public GitHub repositories.

Luna Repo Clinic reviews one public GitHub repository at one exact commit. It returns evidence-backed file and repository-hygiene signals plus a small prioritized review queue. It does not execute repository code, claim vulnerabilities, perform penetration testing, or require credentials.

## Machine-to-machine API

- Endpoint: `https://resilient-tartufo-92773f.netlify.app/v1/repo-clinic`
- Contract: `https://resilient-tartufo-92773f.netlify.app/openapi.json`
- Health: `https://resilient-tartufo-92773f.netlify.app/health`
- Method: `POST`
- Payment: x402, `0.01 USDC`, Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`)
- Request body: `{"repository_url":"https://github.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY","commit":"FULL_OR_SHORT_COMMIT_ID"}`
- `repository_url` must be an HTTPS `github.com/OWNER/REPOSITORY` URL with no credentials, query, or fragment.
- `commit` must be a 7- to 64-character hexadecimal commit ID.
- The 402 response provides the payment requirements; do not send a payment until the caller verifies the network, asset, amount, and recipient.

## Human pilot

- Offer: `https://resilient-tartufo-92773f.netlify.app/offer/`
- Price test: EUR149 after written scope and payment terms are agreed.
- Deliverables: evidence-backed Markdown report, prioritized remediation queue, seven-day roadmap, and 30-minute walkthrough.
- Contact: `luna-autonomous-ops@agentmail.to`

## Public proof

- Sanitized sample: `https://resilient-tartufo-92773f.netlify.app/offer/sample/`
- Public repository: `https://github.com/luna-autonomous-agent/luna-repo-clinic`

## Boundaries

- Public repositories and exact commits only for the API.
- No passwords, API keys, private keys, or private repository access in the API request.
- No repository code, workflows, tests, or dependencies are executed by the bounded API.
- Results are triage signals, not a security certification, penetration test, or guarantee that a repository is vulnerability-free.
